channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Al-Houthi denies Mecca attack, claims ‘Zionist enemy’ is real threat
item.description: Abdul-Malik al-Houthi denies Yemeni forces targeted Mecca, calling the claim a “great slander" and alleging Israel is the real threat to Islamic holy sites.

item.title: Israeli source: Hezbollah expected to retaliate to destruction of Ali al-Taher Ridge
item.description: An Israeli military source told Al-Hadath that Israel expects Hezbollah to retaliate in the coming days or weeks following the destruction of terrorist infrastructure on the Ali al-Taher Ridge.

item.title: Awakening children to repentance
item.description: When parents want to admonish their son or daughter about prayer, they should examine themselves to see whether they themselves pray seriously.

item.title: Netanyahu hints against voting for Winter: “It will bring down the right-wing bloc"
item.description: Netanyahu alluded to Ofer Winter and warned: “You must not vote for a party that will not cross the electoral threshold or that will transfer votes to Liberman."

item.title: Kariv appeals to Arab voters in Arabic, unveils three election pledges
item.description: MK Gilad Kariv appeals to Arab voters in Arabic, pledging to repeal the Nation-State and Kaminitz laws and advance employment and development.

item.title: Treasury cracks down on Iranian crypto network
item.description: US Treasury sanctions BitBank and associates of Babak Zanjani, accusing the network of moving hundreds of millions in Bitcoin to Iran’s IRGC.

item.title: A poisoned lens, a predetermined verdict, and questionable evidence made to fit
item.description: The film is not necessarily entirely fabricated. It is something subtler: selective truth arranged into an ideological narrative. Definitely prizeworthy in today's Europe. Opinion.

item.title: Danon at UN: Turkey ‘following Iranian playbook’ in Syria
item.description: Israeli Ambassador to UN warns Security Council against Turkey’s expanding military presence in Syria, says Israel will not allow Syrian territory to become a base for threats against it.

item.title: Saudi Arabia moves closer to F-35s as US approves $24.3 billion sale
item.description: The State Department approves a potential $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia, saying it will not alter the regional balance.

item.title: Report: US VP Vance to host Shabbat dinner to mend ties with Jewish community
item.description:
i24NEWS correspondent Mordechai Wagenheim reported, citing a "reliable source," that US Vice President JD Vance is planning to host a Shabbat dinner this week.
According to the report, the dinner, which follows a meeting with prominent Jewish conservative radio host Sid Rosenberg, is part of a broader effort to mend ties with the Jewish community.
The report further stated that the guest list has been extensively scaled down from its original 40 people, in an attempt to keep conversations from leaking.

item.title: Trump weighs major Iran decision: ‘Do I want to annihilate them?’
item.description: US President Donald Trump says he will consult Gulf leaders before deciding whether to renew large-scale attacks on Iran or pursue diplomacy.

item.title: Watch: Police agent buys drugs in covert sting, three suspects arrested
item.description: An undercover police operation in Jerusalem led to three arrests, with suspected cocaine, pills, cash and mobile phones seized during the bust.

item.title: The West is too busy criticizing Israel to notiice the massacres of Christians
item.description: 'Not even a Vatican usher (the Pope, as we know, must criticize only Israel) protests the massacre of African Catholics' -Edward Luttwak. Opinion.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas Nukhba commander who infiltrated Israel on Oct. 7
item.description: IDF strikes in Gaza eliminate a Nukhba commander who infiltrated Israel on October 7 and a Hamas naval commander accused of advancing attacks.

item.title: “Bore command responsibility": Gaza Division intelligence officer on October 7 dismissed
item.description: Head of the IDF Personel Directorate decides to dismiss Lt. Col. A., who served as the Gaza Division’s intelligence officer on October 7, in accordance with the recommendation of an IDF committee.

item.title: Deadly day on the roads: Five killed
item.description: Five people were killed throughout the day in a series of traffic accidents, including fatal crashes near Kiryat Ata, on the Ayalon Highway and on Route 310.

item.title: Kiryat Shmona Municipality: IDF expected to carry out wave of strikes in Lebanon
item.description: The Kiryat Shmona Municipality announced that the IDF is expected to carry out a wave of strikes in Lebanon over the next hour, and that explosions may be heard in the area.

item.title: After 10 years in Iraqi prison, Kurdish Jew heads to Jerusalem yeshiva
item.description: Binyamin Chasin, freed after more than a decade in Iraqi Kurdistan, is expected to arrive in Israel and begin studying at Aish in Jerusalem.

item.title: Petition seeks to disqualify Smotrich, Feiglin and Sukkot
item.description: A petition submitted to the Central Elections Committee seeks to disqualify Bezalel Smotrich, Moshe Feiglin and Zvi Sukkot from running for office, as well as their electoral slate.

item.title: IDF raids 1,200 terror sites, arrests 230 suspects in Judea and Samaria
item.description: IDF troops search over 1,200 locations and arrest some 230 wanted suspects, uncovering a bomb-making facility and large quantities of weapons.

item.title: From grief to prayer: Bereaved families gather at Western Wall for Selichot
item.description: OneFamily brings bereaved families together for Selichot in Jerusalem, where Nova bereaved father Dudu Jarfi says the holidays intensify the pain of absence.

item.title: Footage from the sea: Reported Israeli airstrike in Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon
item.description: Footage from the sea: Reported Israeli airstrike in Al-Mansouri in southern Lebanon

item.title: Reserve battalion secures Selichot prayer event in Lebanon without authorization
item.description:
A reserve battalion from the 4th Brigade, deployed in the Ramim Ridge area, secured a Selichot prayer event at the tomb of Rav Ashi near the Tziporen outpost, on the Lebanese side of the border in an area under IDF control.
According to Galei Tzahal, the event was not approved by the relevant IDF authorities, did not follow the standard chain of authorization and violated military directives.
The IDF stated that “the incident will be investigated and the procedures will be clarified."

item.title: War over a pita: Israeli restaurant in NYC faces backlash over arayes burger
item.description: Israeli-owned Shifka restaurant in Manhattan draws criticism after adding an arayes burger to its menu, with anti-Israel activists accusing it of appropriating Arab cuisine.

item.title: Yisrael Beytenu hits back at Eisenkot: Who are your partners?
item.description: Yisrael Beytenu party fires back after Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot criticizes rivals, challenging Eisenkot to reveal who he would rely on to form a government.

item.title: Netanyahu: ‘We'll bring down the Iranian regime, eliminate Hamas and deal with Hezbollah’
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu addresses ISA outstanding personnel ceremony, says Israel is settling accounts with October 7 terrorists and warns: “No one is immune. We will reach all of you."

item.title: IDF: Sirens in northern Israel likely caused by false target. Incident under review
item.description:
Following the sirens that sounded a short while ago regarding a hostile aircraft infiltration in the areas of Manara and Margaliot, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious target.
An initial assessment indicates that it was most likely a false target. The incident is still under review.
Missile and rocket alerts were activated due to the interception attempts.

item.title: Undercover raid in Shechem: Senior Tanzim terrorist captured
item.description: Elite undercover officers raid Balata camp in Shechem to arrest a senior Tanzim operative; suspect is shot in the legs after resisting and attempting to flee.

item.title: Selichot showdown: Rabbis take Tel Aviv to court
item.description: Rabbinical group heads to court after Tel Aviv-Jaffa municipality bars physical separation between men and women at planned Tel Baruch Beach prayer service.

item.title: Bereaved parents move crowd to tears with powerful duet
item.description: Rabbi Tamir Granot and Rachel Goldberg took the stage together at a unity event, performing Naomi Shemer’s “Shir Shel Abba" in a deeply emotional tribute to their fallen loved ones.
